title: The role of zinc finger linkers in zinc finger protein binding to DNA.
authors: Hamed, Mazen Y; Siam, Reema; Zaid, Roza
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟和MM-GB(PBSA)研究锌指蛋白linker突变对TF-DNA结合亲和力的影响，聚焦于TF-DNA互作机制与动态结合机理，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: Zinc finger proteins (ZFP) play important roles in cellular processes. The DNA binding region of ZFP consists of 3 zinc finger DNA binding domains connected by amino acid linkers, the sequence TGQKP connects ZF1 and ZF2, and TGEKP connects ZF2 with ZF3. Linkers act to tune the zinc finger protein in the right position to bind its DNA target, the type of amino acid residues and length of linkers reflect on ZF1-ZF2-ZF3 interactions and contribute to the search and recognition process of ZF protein to its DNA target. Linker mutations and the affinity of the resulting mutants to specific and nonspecific DNA targets were studied by MD simulations and MM_GB(PB)SA. The affinity of mutants to DNA varied with type and position of amino acid residue. Mutation of K in TGQKP resulted in loss in affinity due to the loss of positive K interaction with phosphates, mutation of G showed loss in affinity to DNA, WT protein and all linker mutants showed loss in affinity to a nonspecific DNA target, this finding confirms previous reports which interpreted this loss in affinity as due to ZF1 having an anchoring role, and ZF3 playing an explorer role in the binding mechanism. The change in ZFP-DNA affinity with linker mutations is discussed in view of protein structure and role of linker residues in binding.
abstract_zh: 锌指蛋白（ZFP）在细胞过程中扮演重要角色。ZFP的DNA结合区域由3个锌指DNA结合域组成，这些结构域通过氨基酸连接肽相连，序列TGQKP连接ZF1和ZF2，而TGEKP连接ZF2与ZF3。连接肽的作用是调节锌指蛋白正确定位以结合其DNA靶标，氨基酸残基的类型和连接肽的长度反映在ZF1-ZF2-ZF3相互作用上，并有助于ZF蛋白对其DNA靶标的搜索和识别过程。通过分子动力学（MD）模拟和MM_GB(PB)SA方法，研究了连接肽突变及所得突变体对特异性和非特异性DNA靶标的亲和力。突变体对DNA的亲和力随氨基酸残基的类型和位置而变化。TGQKP中K的突变导致亲和力丧失，原因是失去了K与磷酸基团的正电荷相互作用；G的突变显示对DNA的亲和力降低；野生型蛋白和所有连接肽突变体对非特异性DNA靶标的亲和力均降低，这一发现证实了先前的研究报告，该报告将这种亲和力丧失解释为ZF1在结合机制中起锚定作用，而ZF3起探索作用。本文从蛋白质结构和连接肽残基在结合中的作用角度，讨论了ZFP-DNA亲和力随连接肽突变的变化。
